description: Increase image resolution and optionally enhance visual quality.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the image to upscale. Width and height must each be at most 4096 pixels.

fields.name: magnification
fields.description: Upscaling magnification factor from 1 to 4. Decimal values are supported.

fields.name: enhanceQuality
fields.description: Whether to enhance image quality during upscaling.
